## Source and permission

Link or minimal rights-cleared/synthetic excerpt. Do not upload private or
copyrighted full recordings/transcripts.

## Actual output

Relevant passage and unit/segment IDs, if available.

## Missing or unsupported detail

What should change? Why would this affect the reader's understanding?

## Environment

Skill version, host/model if known, full/partial/unknown input scope,
whether executable audit ran, and remaining limitations.
